data.description:
## Context / Problem

A non-blocking PASS under either engine must earn the same certification: a signed plan-review attestation the claim gate, the close gate, `review-plan --status` and `sign-review` accept (ADR 0049, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py`). For the two engines to be auditable side by side, the attestation must also record which engine produced it.

## Approach

Add an `engine` field (`"pipeline"` or `"agentic"`) to the signed payload that `attest.sign_plan_review` (`attest.py:113`) builds, taken from the verdict's coverage the adapter sets. The field sits inside the signed bytes, so it cannot be edited without breaking the signature. Readers treat a missing field as `"pipeline"`, so every attestation signed before this change keeps validating for claim, close, `--status` and `sign-review`; no migration is written. `resign.py` (re-signing) carries the field forward unchanged. `review-plan --status` and the MCP `plan_review_status` output show the engine. Putting provenance on the attestation itself, rather than only on the sidecar, is what makes it survive sidecar pruning (`sidecar.prune`).

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py (payload field, reader default)
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py (carry forward)
- src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json (engine field)
- the `review-plan --status` renderer and `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py` status output
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_engine.py (new)

## Testing

- Happy path: an agentic PASS signs an attestation with `engine: "agentic"`; the claim gate accepts it, `review-plan --status` reports it current, and `sign-review` re-certifies it with the field intact.
- Back-compat: a fixture attestation without the field validates and reads as `"pipeline"`.
- Tamper: editing `engine` in a signed attestation fails signature verification.
- Refusal: an agentic INDETERMINATE or BLOCK is not signed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Agentic PASS attestations record `engine: "agentic"` and are accepted by claim, close, `review-plan --status` and `sign-review`, pinned by `tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_engine.py`.
- [ ] Pre-existing attestations without the field keep validating, pinned by the back-compat test.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Record the plan-review engine on the signed attestation
